House in Henningsvær with sea view and walking distance to everything. Fully furnished and with two large verandas to enjoy both morning and evening sun. 3 bedrooms with double beds and a large room with a double sofa bed and 2 single beds. Bathroom downstairs with shower and bathroom upstairs with bathtub. (Both with toilet). The garage is used by the host as a small "design boutique" for Lofotlys AS (@lofotlys on Insta), but there are still 2 parking spaces for guests.

Guest access
In Henningsvær you can walk to everything. Max. 15 minutes all directions. 2-3 parking spaces on the property available.

Other things to note
We also sell candles made of crowberries and will have a small "design boutique" in the garage during the summer during the day. (Lofotlys AS)
